promptOptimizerLite.replaceSelection.description: When true, replace selected text directly when a selection exists. Otherwise show action picker.

promptOptimizerLite.externalBaseUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible API base URL, such as https://api.example.com/v1. Store API key with the configuration command.

promptOptimizerLite.externalModel.description: Model name for the OpenAI-compatible API.

promptOptimizerLite.autoDownloadLocalMod.description: Download the compact local GGUF model and llama.cpp runtime on demand when no usable route is available.

promptOptimizerLite.localTemplate.description: Few-shot template used by the local model. Auto classifies the prompt.

promptOptimizerLite.showOptimizationTrac.description: Show the original prompt and selected model route alongside the optimized prompt in chat and preview views.

promptOptimizerLite.offerAgentAdapterSet.description: Offer to add managed PromptOpt adapter blocks for Codex and Claude Code when a workspace opens.
